context.en: Praise of Allah, the source of peace.

content.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
content.latin: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dzal-jalali wal-ikram.

translation.id: Ya Allah, Engkaulah keselamatan dan dari-Mu keselamatan. Mahaberkah Engkau, Pemilik keagungan dan kemuliaan.
translation.en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Owner of majesty and honor.

context.en: An affirmation of divine oneness after prayer.

content.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
content.latin: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la syarika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli syai'in qadir.

translation.id: Tidak ada tuhan selain Allah semata, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya. Milik-Nya kerajaan dan pujian; Dia Mahakuasa atas segala sesuatu.
translation.en: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He has power over all things.
